description: Fetch one issue by website_id + issue number, including its full description, recommendation, affected pages, occurrence detail from the latest report (which page/image/URL, snippets), and comment thread. Use comment_on_issue to add analysis or a fix note to the thread.

occurrence_limit.description: Max occurrences to include (default 20); see occurrence_count/truncated.

website_id.description: Website id the issue belongs to.

name: get_issue
title: Get issue detail
